p.name: Release notes 2.8.0 §0
p.text: 2.8.0 replaces the plain phone box on the sign-up screen with a new phone number field that picks the country code on its own. Rolled out to everyone on Android on 7 October.

p.name: Release notes 2.8.1 (hotfix) §0
p.text: 2.8.1 fixes a crash in the phone number field on the sign-up screen when no country is detected. Built 13 October; sent to the App Store the same day.

p.name: ADR 014: Hotfix 2.8.1, no rollback §0
p.text: We ship a hotfix (2.8.1) instead of rolling 2.8.0 back, because the rollback would also remove the new job feed. Owner: Farhan. Decided 10 October.

p.name: App Store and Play status §0
p.text: iPhone 2.8.1 has been waiting for App Store review since 13 October. Android 2.8.1 is built and waiting for sign-off.

p.question: Why are crash-free sessions down since Wednesday?

p.name: Ship Shiftly 2.8.1 today: Android sign-off and iPhone review chase
p.summary: Phone sign-ups fell from about 199 a day to about 11 after 2.8.0 reached Android users on 7 Oct 2026. The phone number field crashes (406 events from 218 users on 2026-10-15). The fix 2.8.1 was built 13 Oct but is not live.

p.name: github_issue: Ship Shiftly 2.8.1 today: Android sign-off and iPhone review chase
p.title: Ship Shiftly 2.8.1 today: Android sign-off and iPhone review chase
p.payload: {"title":"Ship 2.8.1: fix sign-up phone number field crash","body":"New accounts fell from about 238 a day to about 51 a day since 2026-10-07. Phone sign-ups fell from about 199 a day to about 11; Google sign-ups held at 40 to 42. Cause: the new phone number field in 2.8.0 (Android, 7 Oct 2026) crashes when no country is detected (sentry issue 41; 406 events from 218 users on 2026-10-15). Crash-free sessions fell from 99.35% (2026-09-28) to 92.45% (2026-10-15). Fix 2.8.1 was built 13 Oct: iPhone is waiting for App Store review since 13 Oct, Android is waiting for sign-off. Asks: 1) Sign off Android 2.8.1 today. 2) Chase iPhone review. 3) Check new accounts and the phone crash count daily for a week after release. Owner: Farhan (task ship-hotfix-2-8-1)."}

p.question: Why did sign-ups drop this week, and what should we do?
p.answer:
Phone sign-ups broke on 7 Oct 2026 because of a crash in the new phone number box that app release 2.8.0 added. The fix is built but not live, so sign-ups are still blocked. Records run to 15 Oct.

How sure I am:
- Proven: the crash is in the phone number field on the sign-up screen, and release 2.8.0 brought that field [[event:sentry-issue-shiftly-41]] [[page:screen/app/auth/sign-up]] [[event:release-shiftly-2-8-0]].
- Likely: the crash caused the drop. The dates match exactly, but no record links the two directly.

What happened, in order:
1. 2.8.0 reached all Android users on 7 Oct and replaced the plain phone box with a field that picks the country code itself [[document:release-notes-2-8-0]].
2. People still get to the sign-up screen: 397 on 28 Sep, 392 on 15 Oct [[feature:seekers-signup-sign-up-screen-viewed]].
3. "Phone number entered" fell from about 294 a day to about 60 a day, starting 7 Oct [[feature:seekers-signup-phone-number-entered]].
4. The crash shows up there. It first appeared on 7 Oct. On 15 Oct it hit 218 users, with 406 events [[event:sentry-issue-shiftly-41]]. It happens when no country is detected [[document:release-notes-2-8-1]].
5. Phone sign-ups fell from about 199 a day to about 11. Google sign-ups held at 40 to 42 [[channel:app]].
6. New accounts fell from about 238 a day to about 51 a day [[business:shiftly]].
7. Crash-free sessions fell from 99.35% on 28 Sep to 92.45% on 15 Oct [[channel:app]].

What else it hits:
- One step on: the text-code check [[feature:seekers-signup-otp-verified]].
- Two steps on: job-alert texts, referral invites and profile completion [[feature:job-alert-sms]] [[feature:referral-invites]] [[feature:seekers-signup-profile-completed]].
- Employers may start seeing fewer applicants. That is not recorded yet.

Where the fix stands:
- 2.8.1 was built on 13 Oct. iPhone has waited for App Store review since 13 Oct. Android is waiting for sign-off, as of 15 Oct [[document:store-status]].
- On 10 Oct you chose to fix forward, not roll back. A rollback would also remove the new job feed [[decision:014-hotfix-not-rollback]].
- Farhan owns the ship task [[task:ship-hotfix-2-8-1]]. The records show no changes on it.
- The records don't say whether you or Farhan owns the written decision, and they hold no earlier lesson on sign-up drops.
- Not the cause: traffic. People are still reaching the sign-up screen.

Two items are waiting for your OK:
- A fix task for Farhan: sign off Android 2.8.1 today and chase the iPhone review.
- A two-line note to users, set to go out only once 2.8.1 is shipping, as you prefer [[memory:growth-001-1]]. It says: "Phone sign-up is fixed in the latest Shiftly update. Please update the app and try again; you can also sign in with Google."

Next action: approve the fix task now, which takes under a minute.

**Sign-ups stopped because the sign-up screen crashes, and it began on 7 Oct 2026 with app release 2.8.0. This blocks sign-up now, so tell Rhea today. Data runs to 15 Oct.**

- New accounts fell from 262 (1 Oct) to 50 (15 Oct); the daily level stepped down on 2026-10-07, averaging 231.33 before and 50.56 after [[metric:new_accounts]] [[business:shiftly]].
- Phone sign-ups fell from 205 to 10 (1–15 Oct), while Google sign-ups held at 39 to 42 [[channel:app]]. So only the phone route is broken.
- 2.8.0 put a new phone number field on the sign-up screen and reached all Android users on 7 Oct [[document:release-notes-2-8-0]] [[event:release-shiftly-2-8-0]].
- The error tracker shows a crash in that field: "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'country')" [[event:sentry-issue-shiftly-41]]. Crash-free sessions fell from 99.69% (1 Oct) to 92.45% (15 Oct) [[channel:app]].
- The fix, 2.8.1, was built 13 Oct but is not live: iPhone is in App Store review and Android awaits sign-off [[document:store-status]] [[event:release-shiftly-2-8-1]]. Rolling back was ruled out on 10 Oct because it would remove the new job feed [[decision:014-hotfix-not-rollback]].

p.text:
**Finding:** Sign-ups fell on 2026-10-07, the same day release 2.8.0 is dated [[event:release-shiftly-2-8-0]]. That release added a phone number field to the sign-up screen, and it has a fatal crash that is still open. Our records have no "sign-ups" number, so I used new accounts and phone sign-ups in the Shiftly app.

- New accounts averaged 237.56 a day in the 9 days before 2026-10-07 and 50.56 after [[business:shiftly]] [[document:funnel-daily]].
- Phone sign-ups in the Shiftly app averaged 198.56 a day before 2026-10-07 and 11.33 after [[channel:app]].
- The crash is in the phone number field. First seen 2026-10-07, last seen 2026-10-15, with 406 events from 218 users on 2026-10-15 [[event:sentry-issue-shiftly-41]] [[page:screen/app/auth/sign-up]].
- Crash-free sessions fell from 99.35% on 2026-09-28 to 92.45% on 2026-10-15 [[channel:app]].
- The fix is 2.8.1. The iPhone version went to review on 2026-10-13 and is still waiting [[event:ios-version-2-8-1]]. The Android build is waiting for sign-off [[event:release-shiftly-2-8-1]]. Rhea chose to fix forward, not roll back [[decision:014-hotfix-not-rollback]]. Farhan owns the ship task [[task:ship-hotfix-2-8-1]].

p.question: What else breaks if the sign-up screen keeps crashing?
p.answer:
Ten things in your product depend on the sign-up screen [[page:screen/app/auth/sign-up]]. If it keeps crashing, they all break (records to 2026-10-15). Farhan owns the screen.

Hit straight away:
- Your Pune Meta ads send people into the broken screen, so that spend is wasted. Kavya owns them [[campaign:meta-seekers-pune]] (sample numbers).
- "Phone number entered" stops counting. Neha owns that count [[feature:seekers-signup-phone-number-entered]].
- "Sign-up screen viewed" is also affected. Its owner is not recorded [[feature:seekers-signup-sign-up-screen-viewed]].

Hit further down the line, because nobody gets past the screen:
- OTP verified [[feature:seekers-signup-otp-verified]], then profile completed [[feature:seekers-signup-profile-completed]], then first application [[feature:seekers-signup-first-application]].
- Job-alert SMS [[feature:job-alert-sms]] and referral invites [[feature:referral-invites]].
- The employer applicant inbox [[feature:employer-applicant-inbox]] and your "first hire within 7 days" promise to employers [[feature:employer-first-hire-promise]]. Fewer job seekers means fewer applicants for them.

Owners for this second group are not recorded.

The fix, version 2.8.1, is built but not live, so sign-ups are still blocked [[turn:2026-10-16-352226e2]]. It is waiting for your OK [[approval:turn:2026-10-16-352226e2-1]]. Until it ships, consider asking Kavya to pause the Pune ads. As you asked, don't message users until the fix is shipping [[memory:growth-001-1]].

Next action: approve the 2.8.1 shipping task [[approval:turn:2026-10-16-352226e2-1]] (under a minute).

Did pausing the Meta ads cause the sign-up drop?
p.summary:
No. The drop started on 7 Oct 2026, three days before the Meta ads were paused on 10 Oct 2026, so the pause did not cause it.

- Phone sign-ups fell from about 195 a day to about 11 a day from 7 Oct to 15 Oct 2026 [[channel:app]]. The Pune Meta campaign was paused on 10 Oct 2026, and its spend went to 0 that day (sample numbers) [[campaign:meta-seekers-pune]].
- Google sign-ups held: 41 on 2026-09-30 and 42 on 2026-10-15 [[channel:app]].
- People still reached the sign-up screen. Screen views went from 372 to 392 between 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-15 [[feature:seekers-signup-sign-up-screen-viewed…
p.question: Did pausing the Meta ads cause the sign-up drop?
p.answer:
No. The drop started on 7 Oct 2026, three days before the Meta ads were paused on 10 Oct 2026, so the pause did not cause it.

- Phone sign-ups fell from about 195 a day to about 11 a day from 7 Oct to 15 Oct 2026 [[channel:app]]. The Pune Meta campaign was paused on 10 Oct 2026, and its spend went to 0 that day (sample numbers) [[campaign:meta-seekers-pune]].
- Google sign-ups held: 41 on 2026-09-30 and 42 on 2026-10-15 [[channel:app]].
- People still reached the sign-up screen. Screen views went from 372 to 392 between 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-15 [[feature:seekers-signup-sign-up-screen-viewed]]. App opens went from 522 to 506 [[feature:seekers-signup-app-opened]].
- They dropped off at "Phone number entered", from about 294 a day to about 60 from 7 Oct 2026 [[feature:seekers-signup-phone-number-entered]].
- The likely cause is a crash in the new phone number box. Release 2.8.0 added it and reached all Android users on 7 Oct 2026 [[event:release-shiftly-2-8-0]]. The crash was first seen that day and is still unresolved [[event:sentry-issue-shiftly-41]]. The date matches, but it is not proven.
- The fix, 2.8.1, was built on 13 Oct 2026 and is not live on either store. Android waits for sign-off. iPhone waits for Apple's review, as of 15 Oct 2026 [[event:release-shiftly-2-8-1]] [[event:ios-version-2-8-1]].

Keep the Meta ads paused until 2.8.1 is live. Otherwise they send people into the crash.

Next action: approve the task "Ship Shiftly 2.8.1 today: Android sign-off and iPhone review chase" [[approval:turn:2026-10-16-352226e2-1]].

- Release 2.8.1 fixes the crash. It was built on 13 Oct 2026 and sent to the App Store that day [[document:release-notes-2-8-1]].
- As of 15 Oct 2026, the iPhone fix is still waiting for App Store review. The Android fix is waiting for sign-off [[document:store-status]].
- The app numbers you track cover crashes and sign-ups, not star ratings [[channel:app]].

Next action: send Bug Hunter, QA and release, the App Store and Google Play reviews from 7 Oct 2026 to today, so he can check what people said about the phone box.

p.text:
Not recorded. Our records hold no store reviews, review text or star ratings about the phone-number box, so I can't say what people said or how they rated it.

What the records do show about the box:
- Release 2.8.0 replaced the plain phone box with a new field that picks the country code on its own. It reached everyone on Android on 7 Oct 2026 [[document:release-notes-2-8-0]].
- The error tracker logs a crash in that field (a TypeError in PhoneInput) [[event:sentry-issue-shiftly-41]]. This is a crash log, not something a customer wrote.
- Release 2.8.1 fixes the crash when no country is detected. It was built on 13 Oct 2026 and sent to the App Store that day [[document:release-notes-2-8-1]].
- As of 15 Oct 2026, the iPhone 2.8.1 fix has been waiting for App Store review since 13 Oct, and the Android fix is waiting for sign-off [[document:store-status]].
- The app numbers we track cover crashes and sign-ups, not star ratings [[channel:app]].

Next action: send me the reviews from the App Store and Google Play from 7 Oct 2026 to today, and I'll check what people said about the phone box.

p.note: The figures match the data, but the finding stops short of what the owner asked. It says "Cause: not recorded", yet search results show [[document:release-notes-2-8-0]] replaced the plain phone box on the sign-up screen. They also show a hotfix, [[document:release-notes-2-8-1]], built 13 Oct, and [[document:store-status]] says the iPhone build has waited for App Store review since 13 Oct while An…

The eight cited features all came back, but the dependency links that make the "seven parts depend on it" claim were not in any tool result, and Firefighter's cited finding [[finding:2026-10-16-352226e2-oncall-engineer]] was not returned, so the sign-up screen as the crash point is unsupported here. The finding also answers "what breaks" and not "why sign-ups dropped": it should cite the 2.8.0 change to…

The core is supported: the impact check returned 3 items one step away and 10 in all, and the owners match the Cypher result (Kavya, Neha, Farhan). Fix the wording: "Step 2/3/4" reads as sign-up flow steps, but the tool summary calls "Sign-up screen viewed" Step 2 of that flow, so label the groups as "one step / four steps away from the screen" instead. Also drop "7 more" (a subtraction no tool r…

The timing holds up: the drop began 2026-10-07, three days before the 2026-10-10 Meta pause, and earlier steps (app opens, sign-up screen views) held, so the pause is not the cause. Keep the release 2.8.0 link worded as "matches" (a likely cause, not proven), since the 2.8.0 ship date isn't visible in the data I was given and 2.8.1 (crash fix) is still waiting for review.
